about: P36A T9: 20 own sentences that state a mechanic - lives, a target score, a time limit or how the enemies move. Written before any run, not taken from the demand corpus, the dev set or a sealed set. `expect` lists only what the sentence says; director.measure.ts checks whether the built game carries it (draft vs director).
